speakers.note: Lancer never speaks. Lines attached to this speaker are bracketed action directions.
The scientist who noticed what Lancer could do and brought Lancer to the team. In the prequel she is the original courier, and the Concord's FIRST RUNNER.
The Concord's designation for Ilsa Renn's recorded movement profile. The prequel is played as her.

lines.text: [Lancer reads the dispatch on the wall panel and starts running. The panel is not answered.]
Courier Lancer. Your license permits the licensed route only.
[Lancer keeps the permit folded in one hand and the memory drive in the other.]
If you run the lattice before the gate cycle settles, use the service seam. The checkpoint lies, but your line does not.
[Lancer takes the service seam.]
Then carry the parcel through and leave the regulation panel alone.
Schedule update. Ventworks access begins at the next pressure interval.
Step away from the carry case, Lancer. This is an order, not a question.
[Lancer is already past the checkpoint when the order lands, and does not slow down.]
Run where the wind cannot count your steps.
Carrier deviation recorded. Recovery route authorized.
[Lancer steps into the intake shaft and the hatch closes behind them.]
Below the regulation boundary, carrier presence is logged at district level only.
That is the point of the under-city. Down there the Concord knows how many blocks there are, not who is standing in them.
[Lancer taps the capsule twice. It comes in under, low and slow.]
Freight spine throughput restored to pre-Fracture figures. Please keep the line clear.
It says pre-Fracture like it is proud of it.
Boundary breach. Seal number 4-C, quarantine line 12, sector void.
Lancer. There is no sector void. There is a wall, and you are on the wrong side of it.
[Lancer puts a hand flat on the wall, where the other side should be.]
It does. Whole blocks. They keep it quiet so nobody compares numbers.
Regulation failed here. Not because the wind was strong. Because nobody was counting.
Year Zero. Atmospheric regulation offline at 04:12. All containment seals released. No recovery schedule exists.
I ran it. Every open gate in the city that night, and I could not reach the other side fast enough.
[Lancer does not turn around.]
I am the one who was fast enough to notice it breaking.
Lancer. The seams down here are not concrete. They are grown.
Structural patching is within the maintenance mandate. No further comment.
[Lancer scrapes the seam with a fingernail. It comes away warm.]
It grew because it was permitted to. That is what patching is.
That route has been in the Concord records for twenty years. Same line. Same cadence. Every year it runs itself.
I left the route. It did not.
[Lancer watches the model predict the next junction. It is right.]
It only ever learned the parts I was proud of.
You are going to the canopy. I have read the same order you have. I signed it.
[Lancer walks past the checkpoint glass and keeps climbing.]
It says the city stays sealed. It does not say why. I stopped asking why some years ago.
Canopy anchor tension nominal. No traffic is scheduled above the last regulation layer.
[Lancer crosses the anchor line without stopping.]
Final choice available. Open the canopy, or restore the schedule. Both remain within the mandate.
[Lancer sets the drive down on the canopy control and steps back off it.]
Recorded. The choice remains available.
Twelve deviations recorded against the official route. Each is technically legal. One of them is required.
That was my voice. Twenty years of it, running my line to catch couriers like me.
[Lancer waits. Ilsa does not look away from the wall.]
Break it and the war comes back. I would rather be hated by a living world than mourned by a dead one.
CIVIL DEFENSE ADVISORY. ALL CIVILIANS REPORT TO THE NEAREST STATION. REPEAT: ALL CIVILIANS REPORT TO THE NEAREST STATION.
ARTILLERY INBOUND. TAKE COVER BELOW GRADE. TAKE COVER.
Dispatch runner. That breach is the only way through the column. Go.
The hardline key opens the north relay. You carry it. I cannot.
Containment protocol active. All sectors sealed. Return to your assigned position.
Atmospheric canopy closing. No traffic is scheduled above the last regulation layer.
Override signed. The airlocks are sealed. It is done, and it is not mine to undo.
CONTAINMENT COMPLETE. ZERO ACTIVE COMBATANTS. REMAIN IN ASSIGNED SECTOR.
New growth in sector 4-C is within tolerance. No further comment.
